primaryMetaphor: Three floating luminous orbs moving through vertical space to demonstrate high and low elevation contrast
visualContinuity: Three glowing orbs persist throughout all scenes, transforming position and color from center to high to low

scenes.name: Anticipation
scenes.visual: Three luminous orbs (8% canvas height each) materialize in center of canvas with gentle floating motion. Gradient background from dark navy (#1a1a2e) at bottom to deep indigo (#667eea) at top. Orbs have soft gradient glow, positioned centrally with subtle parallax breathing animation.

scenes.name: High

keySync.visualEvent: orbs reach peak position with spring bounce

scenes.visual: The three orbs elegantly ascend to upper third of canvas (20% from top). They scale to 120% size, shift to cool indigo/cyan colors (#667eea), and intensify their glow. Background gradient shifts upward. Spring physics creates satisfying bounce at peak position.

scenes.name: And Low

keySync.visualEvent: orbs settle into low position with warm color shift

scenes.visual: The orbs gracefully descend to lower third of canvas (80% from top). They scale to 90% size, shift to warm coral/gold colors (#ff6b6b, #feca57), and soften their glow. Background gradient deepens. Smooth settling motion with gentle easing creates sense of grounding and completion.
